records.subject: MATH
records.title: Basic Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: A minimum ALEKS math placement score of 1%.
records.description: Review of basic arithmetic and elementary algebra. No credit earned toward degree.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Algebra Methods and Introduction to Functions
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 100 with an S, a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 40%, or transfer credit for Intermediate Algebra equivalent to MATH 101.
records.description: Fundamental algebraic operations and concepts, linear systems and inequalities, polynomial and rational functions, introduction to exponential and logarithmic functions.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Exploring Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 103, or 251, each with a C or better, STAT 212 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 45%, or transfer credit for Intermediate Algebra equivalent to MATH 101.
records.description: Nature and scope of modern mathematics, and its relationships to other disciplines.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: College Algebra
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 103 with a C or better, a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 70%, or transfer credit for Intermediate Algebra equivalent to MATH 101.
records.description: Graphs, properties and applications of polynomial, rational, exponential and logarithmic functions.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Trigonometry
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 with a C or better.
records.description: Graphs, properties and applications of trigonometric functions.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematics Acceleration
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: A minimum ALEKS math placement score of 78% or concurrent enrollment in MATH 171.
records.description: Individualized instruction on mathematical skills to enhance the mathematical background necessary for success in MATH 171.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematics Tutorial for Pre-calculus
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment in either MATH 106 or 108.
records.description: Individualized instruction on mathematical skills to enhance the mathematical background necessary for success in MATH 106 and 108.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Math 105 Tutorial
records.description: Tutorial for MATH 105 focusing on concept development and mastery; skill proficiency.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Math 106 Tutorial
records.description: Tutorial for MATH 106 focusing on concept development and mastery; skill proficiency.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Calculus for Life Scientists
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 with a C or better and MATH 108 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.  Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for MATH 171, 202 or DATA 121 except by department consent.
records.description: Differential and integral calculus with emphasis on life science applications. By department consent, credit may be allowed for two of MATH 140, 171, 202, or DATA 121.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Calculus I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 with a C or better and MATH 108 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 83%.  Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for MATH 140, 202 or DATA 121 except by department consent.
records.description: Differential and integral calculus of one variable with associated analytic geometry.  By department consent, credit may be allowed for two of MATH 140, 171, or 202.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Calculus II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 171 with a C or better.
records.description: Techniques and applications of one-variable calculus; estimations; series, derivative of a vector function.  Credit not granted for both MATH 172 and 182.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Honors Calculus II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 171 with a C or better.
records.description: Single variable calculus, series, with emphasis on conceptual development and problem solving.  Credit not granted for both MATH 172 and 182.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematics for Business and Economics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 103 with a C or better, a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 65%, or transfer credit for Intermediate Algebra equivalent to MATH 101.
records.description: Mathematical analysis using polynomial, exponential, and logarithmic functions; linear systems, linear programming and mathematics of finance, for business/economic applications and modeling.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Calculus for Business and Economics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 with a C or better, MATH 201 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.  Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned for MATH 140,171 or DATA 121 except by department consent.
records.description: Differential calculus of the polynomial, exponential, and logarithmic functions; focus on unconstrained and constrained optimization, single and partial differentiation. By department consent, credit may be allowed for two of MATH 140, 171, or 202.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Discrete Structures
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: Discrete mathematics, trees, graphs, elementary logic, and combinatorics with application to computer science.  Recommended preparation:  Programming course.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introductory Linear Algebra
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: Solving linear systems, matrices, determinants, subspaces, eigenvalues, orthogonality.  Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 220, 225, and 230.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Linear Algebra with Modern Applications
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: Solving linear systems, matrices, determinants, subspaces, eigenvalues, orthogonality, machine learning, AI, computer graphics, and economic models.  (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 225, DATA 225.)  Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 225, 220, and 230.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Honors Introductory Linear Algebra
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: An introduction to linear algebra with an emphasis on conceptual development.  Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 230, 220, and 225.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Fundamentals of Elementary Mathematics I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 103, 105, 106, or 201, each with a C or better, or STAT 212 with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 45%, or transfer credit for Intermediate Algebra equivalent to MATH 101.
records.description: Comprehensive development of number systems emphasizing place-value, integers, rational numbers, and associated algorithms; methods of problem solving.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Fundamentals of Elementary Mathematics II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 251 with a C or better.
records.description: Inquiry-based approach to fundamental concepts: measurement, geometrical constructions, similarity, congruence, symmetry, probability, counting principles, measures of central tendency, and distributions.  Required preparation:  One year of high school geometry.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Calculus III
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 172 with a C or better, or MATH 182 with a C or better.
records.description: Calculus of functions of several variables.  Credit not granted for both MATH 273 and 283.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Honors Calculus III
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 172 with a B or better, or MATH 182 with a C or better.
records.description: Multivariable calculus with emphasis on conceptual development and problem solving.  Credit not granted for both MATH 273 and 283.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematical Computing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230.
records.description: Examination of some current computer software for solving mathematical problems.  Recommended preparation:  MATH 315.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Mathematical Reasoning
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230, each with a C or better.
records.description: Mathematical arguments and the writing of proofs.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Theory of Numbers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 172 with a C or better, or MATH 182 with a C or better; MATH 301 with a C or better.
records.description: Divisibility properties of integers; congruences; Diophantine equations; quadratic residues.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Geometry for the Middle School Teacher
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 252 with a C or better.
records.description: Topics in 2D and 3D geometry including technology-based reasoning and exploration, deductive arguments, transformational and proportional reasoning, and non-Euclidean geometries.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Differential Equations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 273 or 283, each with a C or better; and MATH 220, 225, or 230, each with a C or better, or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Linear differential equations and systems; series, numerical and qualitative approaches; applications.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Elementary Modern Algebra
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230, each with a C or better; MATH 301.
records.description: Algebra as a deductive system; number systems; groups, rings, and fields.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Elementary Combinatorics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230, each with a C or better.
records.description: Introduction to combinatorial theory: counting methods, binomial coefficients and identities, generating functions, occurrence relations, inclusion-exclusion methods.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Methods of Teaching Secondary School Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 140, 171, or 202, each with a C or better.
records.description: New curricula and pedagogical techniques for secondary school mathematics.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Mathematical Biology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 140 with a C or better, or MATH 172 with a C or better, or MATH 182 with a C or better; BIOLOGY 101, BIOLOGY 102, BIOLOGY 106, or BIOLOGY 107.
records.description: Mathematical biology and development of mathematical modeling for solutions to problems in the life sciences. (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 340, BIOLOGY 340.)

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Algebraic Thinking for the Middle School Teacher
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 252 or MATH 171 with a C or better.
records.description: Algebraic reasoning, classes of functions, translation among models, analytical rule, tables of data, context and coordinate graphs.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Probability and Data Analysis for Middle School Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  MATH 252 with a C or better, or STAT 360 with a C or better.
records.description: Probability and statistics in relation to middle school mathematics and real world problems through visualization, hands-on activities, and technology.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Principles of Optimization
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 202, 220, 225, or 230.
records.description: Algebra of linear inequalities; duality; graphs, transport networks; linear programming; special algorithms; nonlinear programming; selected applications.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematical Snapshots
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 172 or MATH 182.
records.description: Character, life work, and historical importance of mathematicians from various eras and branches of mathematics.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Analysis I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 301 with a C or better.
records.description: Properties of sets and sequences of real numbers; limits, continuity, differentiation and integration of functions; metric spaces.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Analysis II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 401.
records.description: Sequences of functions, power series, multivariable calculus, inverse and implicit function theorems, Lagrange multipliers, change of variable in multiple integrations.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Euclidean and Non-Euclidean Geometry
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 301 with a C or better.
records.description: Geometry as a deductive system of logic; postulational systems; projective and non-Euclidian geometries.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Financial Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 172 or 182.
records.description: Introduction to financial mathematics including the basics of annuities, stocks, bonds, and financial derivatives.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Intermediate Differential Equations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315.
records.description: Linear systems; qualitative theory (existence, uniqueness, stability, periodicity); boundary value problems; applications.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Numerical Simulations for Probabilistic Models
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: STAT 360; CPT S 121, CPT S 215, or MATH 300.
records.description: Efficient generation of random variables; statistical analysis and validation techniques; variance reduction; Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods; applications include complex systems, financial models, and Bayesian computation. Required preparation must include probability and statistics and programming experience. Credit not granted for both MATH 416 and MATH 516.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Linear Algebra
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230, each with a C or better; MATH 301 with a C or better.
records.description: Vector spaces, linear transformations, diagonalizability, normal matrices, inner product spaces, orthogonality, orthogonal projections, least-squares, SVD.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Algebraic Structures
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 301 with a C or better.
records.description: Properties of algebraic structures and their homomorphisms, semi-groups, groups, rings, unique factorization domains, fields.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Intersections of Culture and Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 106, 201, 251, or higher, each with a C or better, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
records.description: Gender/race/ethnicity differences; social consequences; cultural influences on development and learning of mathematics; role of women, people of color in mathematics. Credit not granted for both MATH 431 and 531.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematics for College and Secondary Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 301 with a C or better; junior standing.
records.description: Pre-algebra, algebra functions and geometry examined from an advanced perspective, for secondary and lower level college teachers.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Applied Partial Differential Equations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315.
records.description: Applied partial differential equations; Fourier series; Bessel functions and Legendre polynomials as harmonics for disks and balls; Laplace, heat, and wave equations; separation of variables and D'Alambert's formula. Required preparation must include differential equations. Credit not granted for both MATH 440 and MATH 540.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Complex Variables
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315.
records.description: Complex numbers and complex-valued functions of one complex variable; analytic functions and Cauchy-Riemann equations; differentiation and contour integration; Cauchy integral theorem; Taylor and Laurent series; residues; conformal mapping; applications to potential theory. Required preparation must include differential equations. Credit not granted for both MATH 441 and MATH 541.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Numerical Analysis
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315 with a C or better; one of CPT S 121, 131, or MATH 300, with a C or better.
records.description: Fundamentals of numerical computation; finding zeroes of functions, approximation and interpolation; numerical integration (quadrature); numerical solution of ordinary differential equations. Required preparation must include differential equations and a programming course. (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 448, MATH 548, CPT S 430, CPT S 530.)  Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 448/548 or CPT S 430/530.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Graph Theory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 220, 225, or 230.
records.description: Graphs and their applications, directed graphs, trees, networks, Eulerian and Hamiltonian paths, matrix representations, construction of algorithms. Required preparation must include linear algebra.  Recommended preparation: MATH 301. (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 453, CPT S 453.)

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Introduction to Statistical Theory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:   STAT 430 or 443.
records.description: Sampling distributions; hypothesis testing and estimation; maximum likelihood; likelihood ratio tests; theory of least squares; nonparametrics. Recommended preparation: One 3-credit 400-level STAT or probability course. (Crosslisted course offered as STAT 456, MATH 456.) Credit not granted for more than one of STAT/MATH 456 or STAT 556.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Linear Optimization
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 273 or MATH 283; junior standing.
records.description: Linear and integer programming; optimization problems; applications to economic and military strategies; rectangular games; minimax theory.  Recommended preparation: MATH 301.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Optimization in Networks
records.description: Formulation and solution of network optimization problems including shortest path, maximal flow, minimum cost flow, assignment, covering, postman, and salesman. Credit not granted for both MATH 466 and MATH 566. Required preparation must include linear programming. (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 466/566, CPT S 456/556.)

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Mathematical Methods in Natural Sciences
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 315.
records.description: Introduction to mathematical modeling of natural processes; methods include dimensional and scaling analysis, perturbation theory, field theory of continuum mechanics, calculus of variations, and Markov chains; applications to physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering. Required preparation must include differential equations. Credit not granted for both MATH 486 and MATH 586.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Topics in Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By instructor permission.
records.description: Special topics in mathematics.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Seminar in Mathematical Biology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 140 with a C or better, or MATH 172 with a C or better, or MATH 182 with a C or better; BIOLOGY 101, BIOLOGY 102, BIOLOGY 106, or BIOLOGY 107.
records.description: Oral presentation of research approaches, research results and literature review of mathematical biology including mathematical modeling of biological systems. (Crosslisted course offered as MATH 494, BIOLOGY 494.)

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Instructional Practicum
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By instructor permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MATH
records.title: Special Problems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By department permission.
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
